about_the_game:
Additional DLCs（Vol.1-3）
Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty Season Pass offers a bundle of DLC trilogy at a discount price.
The DLCs will expand your gameplay experience with a whole new storyline with enemies and bosses to overcome, in addition to a new weapon type, armor, and more.

DLC Vol.1 "Battle of Zhongyuan" out now (released June 29, 2023)


DLC Vol.1 "Battle of Zhongyuan" unfolds the saga of Cao Cao's army, who, after the collapse of anti-Dong Zhuo coalition, schemes to expand their influence throughout the Zhongyuan region.
Accompanying this epic story are gameplay expansions including new battlefields, weapons, armor, Divine Beast and demons, alongside a more challenging difficulty mode.

DLC Vol.2 "Conqueror of Jiangdong" out now (released September 27, 2023)


The second DLC "Conqueror of Jiangdong" follows the struggles of Sun Ce after the death of Sun Jian.
New story, generals, stages, weapon type, armor, Divine Beasts, demons, higher difficulty levels, end content, and more will be added.

DLC Vol.3 "Upheaval in Jingxiang" out now (released December 12, 2023)


The third DLC "Upheaval in Jingxiang," depicts Liu Bei's forces as they fight back against the threat of the Elixir that has gripped Jing Province since the death of Yu Ji.
New story, generals, stages, weapon type, armor, Divine Beasts, demons, higher difficulty levels, end content, and more will be added.

Note: You must have an internet connection in order to use various content.
Note: This content requires the full version of the game, which is sold separately. Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty and related updates may also be required.
Note: There is also a product set which includes this item. Please be careful not to purchase duplicate copies.
Note: Please visit the official website for more information.
Note: Completion of the main game may be necessary in order to use some of the Season Pass content.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages: Violence or Gore
